definitions.explanation: The practice of reducing spending and cutting budgets, especially in government or organizational finance. Implies strict belt-tightening measures.

examples.japanese: {緊縮|きんしゅく}⟦{財政|ざいせい}→財政：05757_zaisei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{実施|じっし}する→実施する：19634_jisshisuru⟧。

⟦{政府|せいふ}→政府：03294_seifu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{緊縮|きんしゅく}⟦{予算|よさん}→予算：03663_yosan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{組|く}んで→組む：02050_kumu⟧⟦{財政|ざいせい}→財政：05757_zaisei⟧⟦{赤字|あかじ}→赤字：04712_akaji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{減|へ}らそう→減らす：02414_herasu⟧とした。
examples.english: The government drew up an austerity budget to reduce the fiscal deficit.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長引|ながび}く→長引く：14473_nagabiku⟧⟦{不況|ふきょう}→不況：04844_fukyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{緊縮|きんしゅく}⟦{経営|けいえい}→経営：02740_keiei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{余儀|よぎ}なく→余儀なく：28255_yoginaku⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Due to the prolonged recession, companies are being forced into austerity management.

notes:
USAGE:
Almost always appears as a modifier before financial or economic nouns. Strongly associated with government fiscal policy and corporate cost-cutting. The word carries a serious, formal tone.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {緊縮|きんしゅく}⟦{財政|ざいせい}→財政：05757_zaisei⟧: fiscal austerity
- {緊縮|きんしゅく}⟦{予算|よさん}→予算：03663_yosan⟧: austerity budget
- {緊縮|きんしゅく}⟦{経営|けいえい}→経営：02740_keiei⟧: austerity management
- {緊縮|きんしゅく}⟦{政策|せいさく}→政策：10070_seisaku⟧: austerity policy
